full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic oil painting shows a bearded man leaning heavily over a table crowded with bottles and small glasses in a dim interior. He occupies the center and right, bending forward from a dark blue black coat with his face lowered toward the tabletop. Warm light reveals his short brown hair, thick beard, furrowed brow, and tired inward gaze. One forearm crosses the table edge while the other hand rests near a crumpled pale napkin in the middle. The foreground tablecloth is gray white and rumpled, extending across the bottom half of the frame. At left, several transparent and amber glass bottles rise in a loose group, their necks catching narrow white glints. A small green bottle stands closer to the lower center, and shallow dishes and glass fragments scatter across the near edge. Behind the main man, an older figure in a dark suit is partly cropped at the upper left, with only head and torso visible. Another figure in a muted purple garment stands in shadow near the upper right. The background is a soft mass of brown, olive, charcoal, and black, with little architectural detail, making the sloping body and bright glassware read clearly. The paint is thickest and most broken around reflective objects and folds, while the man's face and hands are smoothly modeled. Diffuse indoor light falls from the upper left, flashing on the glass and tablecloth but leaving the standing figures and far corners in dense shade. The overall composition feels weighted and introspective, using the diagonal human posture to press against a lively scatter of small luminous objects.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形自然主义油画描绘一位蓄须男子沉沉地俯在一张摆满瓶子和小玻璃杯的桌上，周围是昏暗室内。他占据中央与右侧，穿深蓝黑外套向前弯腰，脸低向桌面。暖光显出短棕发、浓胡须、皱起的眉头和疲倦内收的目光。一只前臂横过桌边，另一只手停在中部揉皱的浅色餐巾附近。前景桌布灰白而起皱，延伸过画面下半部。左侧，几只透明和琥珀色玻璃瓶松散地立成一组，瓶颈接住窄窄白色闪光。较小的绿瓶更靠近下方中央，浅盘和玻璃碎光散在近边。主要男子身后，一名穿深色西装的年长人物被左上画边部分裁掉，只看得到头和躯干。另一名穿低饱和紫衣的人站在右上阴影里。背景是棕、橄榄、炭灰和黑色的柔和整体，几乎没有建筑细节，使倾斜身体和明亮玻璃器皿清楚可辨。颜料在反光器物和褶皱附近最厚、最破碎，男子的脸和手则塑形平滑。室内漫射光从左上落下，在玻璃和桌布上闪动，让站立人物及远角留在浓重阴影里。整体构图沉重而内省，以斜向的人体姿态压向一片细小明亮物件的活跃散布。
style_prompt_en: Naturalistic oil painting uses muted charcoal, brown, olive, deep blue, and dirty cream, interrupted by narrow jewel colored and silvery highlights. Broad shadow fields hold the upper and outer composition together, while a lighter diagonal plane across the lower area supplies a stage for clustered small reflections. Rounded forms are modeled softly in warm light, but cloth like and transparent surfaces break into short impasto marks, glints, and irregular edges. Contours are strongest at the meeting of the central dark mass and the pale foreground; deeper forms lose their boundaries into adjoining shade. Scattered high value points create a quick rhythm over otherwise heavy, slow tonal blocks. Diffuse light enters from one upper side and dies out toward the back, giving the near details greater clarity than distant ones. The overall effect is intimate, weighty, and painterly, with selective sparkling texture enlivening a restrained dark palette.
style_prompt_zh: 自然主义油画采用低饱和炭色、棕色、橄榄色、深蓝和灰奶油色，并由狭窄的宝石色与银色高光打断。宽阔阴影把上方及外围构图连成整体，下方较浅的斜向平面则承托成簇的小反光。圆润形体在暖光中柔和塑形，近似布料和透明材质的表面却分解为短促厚涂、闪光与不规则边缘。中央深色体块与浅色前景相接处轮廓最强，更深处的形体则融进邻近暗部而失去边界。散落的高明度点迹在本来厚重缓慢的调子块面上形成快速节奏。漫射光从一侧上方进入，朝后方渐渐消失，使近处细节比远处清楚。整体效果亲密、沉重而有绘画性，选择性的闪亮肌理活跃了克制的暗色配色。
theme_en: A bearded man leaning over a table of bottles in a dim gathering
theme_zh: 昏暗聚会中一位蓄须男子俯身靠在摆满瓶子的桌边
name: Christian Krohg
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
